title.from: Type Asset — Campaign deliverable kinds (LandingPage, Video, ImageSet, SocialCopy, PpcCopy)

description.from:
Parked type spec — do not implement. Not in progress.

## Type: Asset (and/or child deliverable types)

Canonical produced thing under a Campaign. **Not a Slot.** Deliverable kinds may be Asset subtypes or child types.

## Kinds

- **LandingPage** — campaign destination
- **Video** — optional; produced via VideoJob; VideoML renders
- **ImageSet** — stills / thumbnails / crops
- **SocialCopy** — channel `linkedin` | `x` (not Discord)
- **PpcCopy** — headlines and descriptions only; **not** live ad-account writes

Older “thing being promoted” shapes (essay, post, repo, case) can still be an Asset `kind` when the campaign is amplifying existing work. Status for evergreen pieces: `live` / `evergreen` / `retired`.

## Fields (design, not schema)

- **url** (when it exists)
- **kind** (one of the above)
- **track**: `hire` | `human`
- **campaign** (parent)
- **status**: live / evergreen / retired (for lasting assets)

## Out of scope

- No schema code
- No Discord social copy
- No journalist media lists
- PpcCopy does not write to Google Ads / Meta ad accounts
description.to:
Parked type spec — do not implement. Not in progress. Publicist accepted.

**Revised from Asset.** This issue is the Deliverable type. Kind is an **enum on one type**, not five Kanbus types. One production workflow.

## Type: Deliverable

Produced thing under a Campaign, spawned from a Brief. **Not a Slot. Not five types.**

## kind enum

`LandingPage` | `Video` | `ImageSet` | `SocialCopy` | `PpcCopy`

- **SocialCopy** channel is `linkedin` | `x` (not Discord)
- **PpcCopy** is copy limits / draft text only; live spend is **AdDraft**, not a Post
- **Video**: render status lives **on this Deliverable**. There is no VideoJob type. Publicist should not see jobs. VideoML is the renderer.

## One production workflow

Same states for every kind (fields/states vary: LP SLA, legal, brand kit, UTM — not types).

## Out of scope

- No schema
- No Discord
- No journalist lists
- Do not split kind into five issue types
- Do not expose VideoJob to Publicist
